facts.statement: Planned for the rest of 2009: Fishing, holiday and daily in-game events, streamlined UI, clothing dyes.
facts.quote: Through the end of the year we are also adding Fishing, holiday and daily in-game events

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: An official news post (captured November 2009) announcing the 'Job Sampling' system: from the next update, characters created after November 1, 2009 on free accounts can play all jobs up to level 5, while Adventurer and Card Duelist stay free to level 20. It also previews simplified pet tricks with trophies, new pets, housing, fishing, events, UI changes and clothing dyes.
